title: Dilute Spacetime
text: Combine one Rough Alchemical Energy Core, 10 B of Void Starflow and 10 B of Decayed Timeflow in the Large Alchemical Reaction Pool. No catalyst block is required. The products are 1 B of Dilute Spacetime and one Alchemical Waste.

Dilute Spacetime is a gently luminous, water-like fluid that can form infinite sources. Liquid Crystal Balls supply it indefinitely to external extraction, while manual container transfers still use the actual stored amount.
